MANDATORY SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE
Off Calendar Dec-04-2003 Off Calendar
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for settlement conference hearing this day in Dept. 218, Commissioner Sue M. Kaplan, Clerks: V.Mack/S Ravinantapricha, Reporter: Valerie Papale CSR: #6899
Appearances:
Carole Cullum, Esq., for Plaintiff Mercy Services Corp. with Property Supervisor Barbara Crain.
Davina Countee, Defendant in Pro Per.
Parties met in Dept. 207 with Judge Pro Tem Arnold Evje and reached a settlement by stipulation.
Terms of the ORAL settlement were read into the record as follows:
Plaintiff is entitled to a judgment against the defendant for restitution and possession of the premises of the property located at: 1599 Hayes #102, San Francisco. Defendant owes no rent from 8/1/03 thru 11/30/03. Defendant agrees to pay $2,154.00 by money order no later than 9:00AM on 12/9/03 for Dec. 2003, Jan. 2004 and Feb. 2004. Defendant to vacate the premises no later than 2/28/04 and represents all other occupants vacate the premises by 2/28/04. Defendant agrees to abide by House Rules. If Defendant complies, Plaintiff will file a Dismissal with prejudice by 3/30/04. If Defendant does not comply, Plaintiff will execute Judgment and obtain Writ of possession on 3/1/04. Parties waive further stays of execution and rights to appeal. All property left at the premises after 2/28/04 shall be deems abandoned. Defendant surrenders security deposit in lieu of back rent. Each party waives claim against the other, including claims under Civil Code 1542. Each to bears its own costs and attorney's fees. Defendant waives any right to make a motion to set aside or vacate the judgment, or to apply for a stay or relief from forfeiture.
All parties agreed to the settlement in open court.
The Court deemed the matter settled and trial date is vacated.
